. fr. mike schmitz parables tour for young people on 20th july in dublin: derry youth ministry is inviting young people aged 16+ to join them for the fr. mike schmitz parables tour taking place on 20th july 2026 in the national stadium dublin. fr. mike is an american priest and digital evangelist, who will present the message of the gospel in a novel, energetic and engaging style that speaks into young people's lives today. there will be a special mass for youth attending from all over ireland to begin the evening celebrations. cost is £45 for ticket and transport. bus departs derry at 12noon, with pick-ups in strabane and omagh. to secure your place or for more information, contact

. atu st. angela’s is inviting applications for the following programme beginning autumn 2026: part-time certificate in religious education for primary school, with online delivery. the programme is open to: qualified primary school teachers; qualified post-primary school teachers who wish to transfer to primary school teaching. parents, sacramental preparation teams and parish catechists who have a specific interest in the area of primary religious education may also apply. closing date for applications is friday 14th august. for further information, contact mary kearns, senior administrator, education department, atu st. angela’s, lough gill, sligo. email:
